comparison.objective: Extract a slip-sheet while bracing a load; candidate commissions an adjustable axis damper through unlock-adjust-test-lock cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; sheet extraction differs from hex-key insertion, collar adjustment, torque-limited locking, and response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Requires retaining a 350 g block during extraction; candidate requires two safe ≥0.85 J impacts, ≤12 mm travel, no hard-stop strike/rebound/overload, and bounded collar drift. Sheet displacement thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The tested manipulation and outcome differ meaningfully despite bimanual bracing.
